A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AdamW-GS research. All 35 pages in each version, including Appendices A–K, equations, 30 tables, and 10 figures, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v4 reports original reconstruction, primitive-count, runtime, and ablation results in the main text and appendices, including evaluations on Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks & Temples, Deep Blending, and OMMO.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons, additional pipeline evaluations, and per-scene ablations in Appendix K.

M1.justification: AdamW-GS retains the same Sparse Adam, Re-State Regularization, and Decoupled Attribute Regularization components. The update equations, sampling procedures, opacity/scaling regularization, noise handling, and pipeline adaptations are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same datasets and scenarios, including OMMO in Appendix E.4. The DBS Treehill exclusion and OMMO scene #10 preprocessing failure are retained; caption corrections do not change coverage.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain the same baselines and variants, including RePR, MaskGaussian, Taming-3DGS, DBS, and AdamW-style regularization. Table 9 corrects an erroneous reference to Taming-3DGS in its caption; its evaluated method remains DBS.

E3.justification: The every-eighth-image test split, reconstruction metrics, opacity threshold, training schedules, and experiment configurations are retained. The extended densification experiment in Appendix F and the schedules in Figure 9 already appear in v4.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same AIU, RSR, DAR, noise, opacity-reset, and hyperparameter analyses. Appendix F's additional exploration strategies and Appendix G's failure cases retain their experiments and evidence.

E5.justification: Figure 8 retains the same PSNR error bars and uncertainty-related caption. No run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or statistical estimation procedures are added or removed.

E6.justification: Tables 1–30 retain their numerical results, including all 312 GS/MC rows in Appendix K, and the plotted results are unchanged. For example, both versions report MC8 PSNR of 28.219 and GS8 runtime of 18.53 minutes in Table 3.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–25 remain equivalent, with no added proofs or revised derivations. Appendix J.2's added parenthetical N_I/10 restates the previously described one-order-of-magnitude scaling.

C1.justification: The abstract is identical. The rewritten introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: analyzing optimization coupling, proposing AdamW-GS, improving efficiency and reconstruction, and reducing redundancy without additional pruning operations.

C2.justification: Section 5.1 makes the explanation of indoor noise sensitivity more tentative, explicitly suggesting that smaller primitive sets may increase sensitivity. Appendix E.2 now describes the unchanged primitive-count figures as peak counts underlying memory savings. These are limited interpretive refinements; the principal limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The hardware disclosure, implementation equations, hyperparameters, sampling intervals, and code/data pointers are retained. The explicit N_I/10 notation in Appendix J.2 clarifies an already disclosed operation rather than supplying a new setting.

R1.justification: The introduction substitutes Kerbl et al. (2023) for Papantonakis et al. (2024) beside the vanilla 3DGS framework, and Section 4.4 drops the Kheradmand et al. citation attached to opacity correction. These are limited attribution edits; the bibliography and broader research positioning are unchanged.

P1.justification: Extensive sentence and paragraph rewriting spans the introduction, related work, methodology, results, conclusion, and several appendices. Grammar, terminology, and explanations are revised throughout, although the section hierarchy and scientific content remain largely stable.

P2.justification: Numerous captions receive wording corrections, including Table 9's DBS identification and Appendix K's dataset spelling. Text, equations, and some table positions reflow locally, while the figure assets, table structures, and overall visual organization are retained.

improvement.justification: v5 improves readability through clearer descriptions of synchronous updates and gradient coupling, widespread language editing, and corrections such as Table 9's misleading Taming-3DGS reference. The methods and empirical evidence remain unchanged, and some awkward prose and resource-reporting ambiguity persist, so the overall quality gain is limited.
